reason: The sole cited evidence (E1) discusses AIMD-based entropy estimation for elemental Ti and mentions flexibility of a probability-distribution method, but it provides no support for POD, reduced-order modeling, mode reconstruction, or speed/accuracy claims in multicomponent alloys. The key premises are entirely unsupported by the cited passage.
premises: POD can extract dominant vibrational eigenmodes from short MD trajectories that capture anharmonicity and electron-vibration coupling.
A reduced set of POD modes can reconstruct the free energy landscape with fidelity comparable to full TOR-TILD/AIMD.
Sensitivity analysis can calibrate the number of retained modes to ensure crucial entropy contributions are not lost.
The approach will yield ~100-1000x speed-up for multicomponent high-entropy alloys.
The method will maintain accuracy within ~0.05 eV/atom of full AIMD/TOR-TILD.
